responseText:
I can’t run in the background or proactively message you later — I don’t have the ability to keep working while you’re away or send you a follow-up after a few hours. I might be misunderstanding your intent; if you want me to do work now and deliver results in this session, or to prepare something you can schedule to notify yourself, I can do that immediately.

Options you can pick from (I can help set any of these up right now):

1) I work on the task now until it’s finished, and give you the result in this chat. (Tell me the task, allowed time, and any constraints.)

2) I create a clear plan and deliverables with estimated steps and time needed, so you can come back later and review. (Tell me the task and deadline.)

3) I prepare the finished message or deliverable plus instructions you can schedule to be sent to yourself (via Gmail, Outlook, Slack, Calendar, etc.). I can draft the exact text to schedule and give step‑by‑step instructions for scheduling it.

4) I provide automation instructions/scripts (Zapier, IFTTT, cron, or an email scheduler) that will send you a notification when the work is done — I can create the Zap/IFTTT recipe or example cron/email script for you to run.

Quick how-to examples (I can fill in exact text for you):
- Gmail: Compose → arrow on Send → Schedule send → pick date & time.
- Google Calendar: Create event → Add notification (email or popup) → set time.
- Outlook (desktop): Options → Delay Delivery → Do not deliver before → set date/time.
- Slack: Type message → click the small arrow by Send → Schedule message → pick time.
- Zapier: Use “Schedule by Zapier” trigger → action to send email/Slack message.

If you want me to draft the message to be scheduled, here’s a short template I can customize:
- Subject: [Task name] — Completed
- Body: Short summary of results, link to deliverable or attachment, next steps (if any).

Tell me:
- What exactly is “this” (task details and deliverable)?
- Which option above do you prefer?
- When do you want the notification (date/time and time zone) and by which channel (email, Slack, calendar, etc.)?

I can start immediately once you tell me which option and provide task details. I’m unable to wait and message you later on my own.
